title: The Champagne Side-by-Side Bachelorette
description:
Kick back with a cold drink in our balconies and soak up the relaxed feel at this modern home in the heart of music city. Clean lines, perfect decor, and polished dark wood floors create a stylish backdrop for rustic and industrial accents. Enjoy our video games, super Jenga, and the vintage arcade games.

Both units are included in the price.
